messages.text: How do changes in Wi-Fi 7/8 technology affect the measurement capability required from Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer?

Wi‑Fi 7/8 pushes signal generator and signal analyzer requirements upward in three main directions: **wider instantaneous bandwidth, cleaner modulation/EVM performance, and more parallel/realistic multi-radio testing**.

### 1) Bandwidth: from 160 MHz to 320 MHz and beyond planning
For Wi‑Fi 7 / IEEE 802.11be, the knowledge base identifies **320 MHz channel bandwidth** as a key throughput component, and notes Wi‑Fi 7 OTA solutions supporting bandwidth up to **320 MHz**. This means a signal generator/analyzer must support at least:

- **320 MHz WLAN waveform generation and analysis**
- Enough **instantaneous analysis bandwidth** to capture the full channel
- Flat amplitude/phase response and calibrated corrections across that bandwidth
- Adjacent-channel and spectral mask analysis over wider spans

Source: Wi‑Fi 7 key components include **320 MHz channel bandwidth**, **4096QAM**, up to **16 spatial streams**, and **MLO**; Bluetest/R&S Wi‑Fi 7 OTA capability supports bandwidth up to **320 MHz**. [Knowledge: Wi‑Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]

### 2) Modulation and EVM: 4096QAM tightens RF quality
Wi‑Fi 7 adds **4096QAM**, which increases sensitivity to impairments such as:

- Phase noise
- IQ imbalance
- Frequency error
- Nonlinear compression
- Residual EVM of the test instrument itself

So the generator needs **very low EVM waveform output**, and the analyzer needs a **lower residual EVM floor** than the DUT requirement. Otherwise the test equipment masks the DUT’s real performance.

Practical impact:

- Better vector signal generator modulation quality
- Lower analyzer noise and distortion
- More accurate phase-noise and EVM decomposition
- Good calibration for wideband frequency response

Source: Wi‑Fi 7 throughput-related components include **4096 QAM modulation**. [Knowledge: Wi‑Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]

### 3) MIMO and MLO: more RF chains must be generated/analyzed together
Wi‑Fi 7 introduces/expands **MLO — multi-link operation** — and the knowledge base notes that MLO makes **multiple RF chains** important in the test environment. Wi‑Fi 7 is also associated with up to **16 spatial streams**.

That changes the test requirement from “one clean RF channel” to **multi-channel, synchronized RF generation and analysis**, including:

- Multiple coherent RF outputs/inputs
- Time alignment between channels
- Phase-coherent MIMO measurements where needed
- Cross-link behavior for MLO across 2.4/5/6 GHz bands
- Simultaneous traffic/performance analysis, not just single-link PHY checks

Source: MLO is identified as a Wi‑Fi 7 key feature, and the knowledge base says multiple RF chains are critical for Wi‑Fi 7 test environments. [Knowledge: Wi‑Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]

### 4) OTA and realistic environment testing become more important
Because antenna/RF interaction is central for MIMO and MLO, conducted testing alone is not enough for many Wi‑Fi 7 devices. The knowledge base notes that Wi‑Fi 7 development needs measurements of antennas and RF transmitter/receiver characteristics under **real-world conditions in signaling mode**, and describes OTA reverberation chamber integrations using R&S CMX500 with Bluetest/EMITE systems.

This implies test systems need:

- OTA chamber integration
- Signaling mode operation
- Realistic multipath/MIMO stress testing
- Receiver sensitivity, throughput, PER and BLER-style performance checks under controlled RF conditions

Source: Wi‑Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing pages describe R&S CMX500 integration with Bluetest/EMITE OTA environments for Wi‑Fi 7 stations and APs. [Knowledge: Wi‑Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing; R&S CMX500 OBT]

### 5) Puncturing, MRU and scheduling: analyzers must understand more complex OFDMA structures
For Wi‑Fi 7, features such as preamble puncturing and multi-resource-unit behavior mean the analyzer must not only measure “one contiguous channel,” but decode and evaluate the actual occupied resource structure.

Required capabilities include:

- OFDMA resource-unit aware demodulation
- Punctured-channel spectral analysis
- Per-RU or per-user EVM
- Triggering/capture of bursty, scheduled transmissions
- Correct interpretation of 802.11be frame formats

The knowledge result did not provide detailed raw evidence on puncturing/MRU specifically, so this part is a general technical implication, not directly cited from the knowledge base.

### 6) Latency and reliability: move from PHY-only to traffic/application-aware testing
Wi‑Fi 7 targets very high throughput and low latency applications such as UHD video, VR and AR. The knowledge base states Wi‑Fi 7 is aimed at **extremely high data throughput**, **tens of gigabits per second**, and **low latency** applications.

So test equipment needs to measure not only RF parameters, but also:

- Packet error rate / throughput
- Latency under load
- Multi-link failover or link steering behavior
- Coexistence/desense with cellular, Bluetooth or other radios
- Application-layer traffic behavior where relevant

Source: Wi‑Fi 7 is described as targeting extremely high throughput, tens of Gbit/s, low latency, UHD video, VR and AR. [Knowledge: Wi‑Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]

### 7) Wi‑Fi 8 / 802.11bn: emphasis likely shifts further toward reliability, coordination and deterministic performance
The knowledge base evidence specifically mentions that R&S CMX500 features include WLAN signaling and TX measurements covering **802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be and 802.11bn**, with **2x2 MIMO** listed in that CMX500 context. [Knowledge: R&S CMX500]

The knowledge base did not provide detailed Wi‑Fi 8 feature evidence beyond the 802.11bn mention. From general industry knowledge, Wi‑Fi 8 is expected to focus less on another headline peak-rate jump and more on:

- Better reliability
- Lower latency variation
- Coordinated multi-AP operation
- More deterministic performance
- Improved operation in dense networks

For signal generators/analyzers, that means the required capability will likely expand toward:

- Scenario-based multi-device/multi-AP testing
- Repeatable impairment and fading emulation
- Long-duration stability and latency measurements
- Coordinated RF timing and synchronization
- Advanced traffic plus RF correlation

This Wi‑Fi 8 portion is partly general knowledge and should not be treated as knowledge-base-cited evidence except for the CMX500/802.11bn support mention.

---

### Bottom line

Wi‑Fi 7/8 changes the required signal generator/analyzer from a **single-channel RF box** into a **wideband, low-EVM, multi-channel, signaling-capable, OTA-ready test platform**.

Key required capabilities:

| Technology change | Measurement impact |
|---|---|
| 320 MHz channels | Wider generation and analysis bandwidth |
| 4096QAM | Lower residual EVM, better phase noise, better linearity |
| MLO | Multiple synchronized RF chains and multi-link analysis |
| Up to 16 spatial streams | Scalable MIMO/OTA stress testing |
| OTA MIMO behavior | Chamber integration and real-world multipath testing |
| Low-latency applications | Throughput, PER, latency and application-aware testing |
| Wi‑Fi 8 / 802.11bn direction | More reliability, coordination and scenario-based testing |

In short: **the instrument must not only generate and analyze wider Wi‑Fi waveforms, but must also emulate realistic multi-link, multi-radio, multi-antenna operating conditions while preserving enough RF purity to accurately measure very high-order modulation.**

answer.question: How do changes in Wi-Fi 7 and Wi-Fi 8 technology affect the measurement capability required from signal generators and signal analyzers? Include implications for bandwidth, modulation/EVM, MIMO/multi-link operation, puncturing/MRU, latency/reliability, and test equipment requirements.

passages.text:
Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術背景
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 列出的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] throughput-related components 包含：

| 技術項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| 320 MHz channel bandwidth | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| up to 16 spatial streams | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| 4096 QAM modulation | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| [[MLO]] | key component；also key feature making multiple RF chains important |

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 提供 solution-level update：[[Bluetest]] earlier integrated WLAN testing capabilities 現在支援 [[Wi-Fi 7]] bandwidth up to **320 MHz**。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 則以背景段落描述 [[IEEE 802.11be]] / [[Wi-Fi 7]] 是 next generation Wi-Fi technology，面向 extremely high data throughput、tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。

以上皆為來源對 Wi-Fi 7 與整合測試能力的敘述，不等同於 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[Bluetest Flow]]、[[Bluetest]] RTS 或 [[EMITE]] chambers 對所有 feature combination 的完整規格保證。

Bluetest › 來源中的公司定位
- [[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）稱 [[Bluetest AB]] based in Gothenburg, Sweden。
- 同一來源稱 [[Bluetest]] specializes in reverberation chambers，例如 [[Bluetest RTS65]]，用於 efficient over-the-air performance evaluation of wireless devices。
- 同一來源稱 [[Bluetest]] 的 reverberation chamber 技術用於 world-leading mobile phone manufacturers、communications carriers、antenna manufacturers 與 other wireless solutions manufacturers。
- 同一來源說明 [[Bluetest]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 延伸 long-established collaboration，將 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality 整合到 [[Bluetest Flow]]。
- [[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）說明 [[Bluetest]] RTS reverberation chambers simulate realistic indoor and urban environments，並與 [[Bluetest Flow]] control software 組成 integrated test systems，用於 antenna and radio performance validation，包括 [[MIMO]] 與 multi-carrier testing。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源將 wireless products 的 market access approval testing 分成三類：[[Regulatory Compliance Test]]、[[Telecom Industry Certification Test]]、[[Cellular Network Operator Acceptance Test]]。Regulatory compliance 被描述為各區域法律面 market access 的必要條件；industry certification 例子包含 [[GCF]] / Cellular、[[Bluetooth SIG]]、[[FiRa]] / [[UWB]]、[[Wi-Fi Alliance]]；operator acceptance test 例子包含 AT&T、VzW、T-mobile、CMCC。
- 來源主張 wireless products 需要 [[CE marking]] / [[FCC ID]]；test results 是 technical documentation 的一部分，需在產品投放市場前準備、可提供給 surveillance authorities，並自 placed on the market 起保存 10 years。
- 來源列出 Ericsson Mobility Visualizer Jan 2023 的 mobile subscriptions 表，顯示 2022–2028 的 5G subscriptions 由 1046.006 增至 4974.568；但單位與表格數值口徑未在轉檔文字中完整標示。
- [[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]被整理成四類 essential requirements：Art 3.1a Health & Safety、Art 3.1b EMC、Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum、Art 3.3 Specific topics。來源列出多個 ETSI EN standards，例如 [[EN 300 328]]、[[EN 301 893]]、[[EN 303 687]]、[[EN 301 908-1]]、[[EN 301 908-13]]、[[EN 301 908-24]]、[[EN 301 908-25]]、[[EN 301 489-52]] 等。
- 對 [[5G NR SAR testing]]，來源指出 5G NR network emulator is required to drive EUT to extreme transmission condition，multi-radio UE 的 average-SAR feature 需要 flexible signaling functions，涵蓋 cellular standards、Wi-Fi 與 Bluetooth；來源將 [[R&S CMW500]] / [[R&S CMX500]] 稱為 SAR / HAC signaling solution。
- 對 Art 3.1b EMC，來源指出 EMC tests 需要 radio enabled 與 radio disabled conditions，因此 5G NR 也需要 signaling solution；mobile phone 仍需要 [[Audio Breakthrough]] test，從 GSM 到 VoLTE / VoNR by 5G。來源提到 [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]]。
- 對 Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum，來源指出 5G NR specification 包含 FR1 與 FR2；FR1 test setup stays conducted，FR2 test setup becomes radiated；並把 3GPP test cases、CTIA-OTA test cases、TRP / TRS、RSE 測試連到 [[R&S TS8991]] 與 [[R&S TS8996]]。

R&S CMW500 › 支援技術摘要
- [[R&S CMW500]] 在 [[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]] 中是唯一明確支援 GSM small cell、WCDMA small cell、LTE small cell 的 CMW 型號。
- GSM、NB-IoT、WCDMA、LTE mobile station test 與 NR Sub-6GHz 章節明確標示適用於 [[R&S CMW500]] 與 [[R&S CMW290]]。
- Four RF paths、DAU B450H/I、Digital I/Q 1 to 4 / 5 to 8、Digital I/Q QUAD 章節明確標示 [[R&S CMW500]] 與 [[R&S CMW270]]。
- Bluetooth standard：Bluetooth Core Specification Version 5.0；test standard 包含 RF.TS.5.0.0 與 RF-PHY.TS.5.0.0。
- WLAN 160 MHz bandwidth unit 章節列出 IEEE 802.11a/g/p/n/ac 與 IEEE 802.11ax，bandwidth up to 160 MHz。
- [[CMW-KA096_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]] 補充 [[NGeCall over LTE]]、[[IMS eCall]]、[[IVS]]、[[PSAP]]、[[MSD]]、limited service、callback、clear-down、SRVCC handover 等 eCall 測試語境。

CMX500 Callbox › Example Callbox use cases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 的 Example Callbox use cases 進一步列出：

- R&D verification of new bands。
- Sensitivity testing。
- [[RedCap]]。
- [[CMX500 Desense Testing]]。
- [[3GPP Pre-Conformance Testing]]。
- [[CMX500 SRS RF measurements]]。
- UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements。
- UL TX Switching。
- [[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]]。
- High e2e TP testing。
- Non-signaling verification。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 為什麼需要 OTA 與 multiple RF chains
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 指出，在 WLAN devices development 期間，需要在 real-world conditions in signaling mode 下量測 antennas 以及 RF transmitter / receiver characteristics。由於 [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很關鍵。

同一來源同時將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester；其 flexibility、support for multiple radio technologies 與 embedded IP test capabilities 使其可用於 broad range of Wi-Fi 7-specific tests。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 進一步把 Wi-Fi 7 OTA 測試放入更廣的 [[4G 5G NR WLAN OTA MIMO stress testing]] 情境：同一 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] / [[Bluetest]] RTS workflow 同時涵蓋 WiFi、[[LTE]]、5G SA / NSA 的 radio and antenna performance validation。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 沒有使用 MIMO stress testing 一詞，也沒有提供 RF chains、spatial streams 或 chamber reflection model；它的貢獻是確認另一個 OTA chamber vendor [[EMITE]] 也將 [[R&S CMX500]] 整合到 [[Wi-Fi 7]] OTA measurement solution 中。

R&S CMX500 › RF ports 與 routing
- RF Com 1、RF Com 2：simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing；2 × SnapN；RF input/output to DUT。
- RF In 1、RF In 2：transmitter testing；2 × SnapN；RF input from DUT。
- RF Out 1 to RF Out 4：receiver testing；4 × SnapN；RF output to DUT。
- Receiver test functions：四個 RF generators（其中兩個在 GPRF mode）可 routing 到 RF Com 1、RF Com 2、RF Out 1 to RF Out 4。
- Transmitter test functions：RF Com 1、RF Com 2、RF In 1、RF In 2 ports 的四個 input signals 各可 split 到 one or two RF analyzers。
- FDA tables 支援 user-specific frequency-dependent attenuation corrections。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源將 [[EN 303 981]] 測試描述為 antenna characterizations 的 radiated measurement，列出 antenna beam pointing、off/on-axis spurious radiation、carrier suppression / cessation、blocking performance、adjacent signal selectivity、image frequency rejection、WBES location / identification、control and monitoring functions、receive antenna off-axis gain pattern，並連到 [[R&S SMBV100B]]、[[R&S ELEKTRA]]、[[R&S TS8996]]。
- 來源列出 FCC CFR47 §25 Mobile Satellite Service / Mobile Earth Station test items：RF output power、occupied bandwidth、emission mask within 25% of authorized BW、out of band emissions、additional unwanted emission 1559–1610 MHz、carrier-off state emissions 1559–1610 MHz、frequency stability，並提到 ANSI C63.26 / FCC KDBs。
- 最後來源把 primary test instruments for wireless regulatory test labs 分成 wireless communication tester、EMI test receiver、signal & spectrum analyzer、network analyzer、vector signal generator、broadband amplifier 等類別。

passages.text:
CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

R&S CMP180 › Transmitter test functions
- 8 input signals to be multiplexed to RF analyzer no. 1。
- 8 input signals to be multiplexed to RF analyzer no. 2。
- frequency-dependent attenuation（FDA）tables for user-specific corrections，分別對 RF 1.1 to RF 1.8 與 RF 2.1 to RF 2.8。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 來源中的測試架構
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）描述的架構為：

- [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 提供 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- [[Bluetest Flow]] control software / integrated test environment 整合 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- [[Bluetest]] reverberation test systems（RTS），例如 [[Bluetest RTS65]]，提供 reverberation chamber OTA environment。
- 測試對象為 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points。
- 測試目標為 MIMO stress testing under realistic conditions。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）補充：

- [[Bluetest]] expanded its earlier integrated testing capabilities for [[WLAN]] stations and access points（[[IEEE 802.11]] a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be）。
- [[Wi-Fi 7]] 現在支援 bandwidth up to **320 MHz**。
- 此能力與 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18 與 [[Bluetest]] RTS 組成 single tester and reverberation test system 的 integrated path。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）補充：

- [[EMITE]] over-the-air chambers 可 combined with the latest sophisticated testing features of [[R&S CMX500]]。
- 整合 enables support of [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] and [[5G RedCap]]。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為支援 non-cellular technologies including latest [[Wi-Fi 7]]，all in a single instrument。
- [[EMITE]] customers obtain a comprehensive environment for accurately assessing performance of [[Wi-Fi 7]] as well as [[5G RedCap]] devices。

R&S CMX500 OBT › Bluetest RTS / OTA test 語境
依 [[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]]：

- [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 可與 [[Bluetest]] reverberation test systems（RTS）及 [[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18 搭配。
- 支援使用 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 在 Bluetest RTS 中執行 [[5G NR Standalone]]、[[5G NR Non-Standalone]]（EN-DC）與 [[LTE]] testing。
- [[Bluetest]] 也將較早的 [[WLAN]] stations / access points（[[IEEE 802.11]] a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be）integrated testing capabilities 擴充到 [[Wi-Fi 7]] 320 MHz bandwidth support。
- 來源將此整合定位為 single tester and reverberation test system 的 multi-technology validation path。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 與既有知識的關係
- 補強 [[5G NR SAR testing]]：既有頁以 [[SPEAG]] / [[DASY8-3D]] / [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 SAR automation PR 為主；本來源從 CE RED Art 3.1a / FCC SAR / HAC compliance presentation 的角度補入 5G NR network emulator、multi-radio UE、average-SAR 與 CMW/CMX signaling solution。
- 補強 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]]：既有頁只由 [[2025RS Drone Solution]] 支撐 TS9975 作為 UAV EMI system；本來源新增 wireless devices Art 3.1b EMC / ABT context，並與 [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 同列。
- 連接 [[低軌衛星終端設備檢測]]與 [[衛星地球電臺設備技術規範]]：既有頁以台灣 111年08月衛星地球電臺設備草案與 FCC Part 25 對應為主；本來源提供更泛化的 CE RED / ETSI EN 301 681 / EN 303 981 / FCC CFR47 §25 mobile satellite service 視角。
- 與 [[R&S CMW500]] 既有頁相容：既有頁已保存 CMW500 的 NGeCall / LTE capability 與 datasheet；本來源只是簡報層級稱 latest CMW500 SW supports 3GPP R17 NB-NTN signalling，未提供 software version、license 或 test case ID，不應覆蓋正式 datasheet。
- 與 [[R&S SMBV100B]] 既有頁相容：既有頁是 Version 13.01 specifications；本來源只是把 SMBV100B列為 EN 301 681 / EN 303 981 測試中的 signal generator solution，不新增產品規格。

依 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]]：

- [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]] 同列於 Traditional EMC Art 3.1b tests。
- 上下文是 [[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]] Art 3.1b [[EMC]] requirements。
- 來源指出 Art 3.1b EMC test requirements are not changed by 5G NR。
- EMC tests need both enable radio and disable radio conditions, which means signaling solution for 5G NR。
- Mobile phones require [[Audio Breakthrough]] test, from GSM to VoLTE and VoNR by 5G。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

Wi-Fi over mmWave Technology › 測試需求
依 [[R&S for JIO Project]] 與 [[R&S solution for Jio project_202509_r3]]，WoMT 測試至少包含：

- OTA precision measurement：使用 [[R&S ATS1800C]] CATR chamber。
- TX analysis：[[EIRP]]、[[TRP]]、[[ACLR]]、EVM under Wi-Fi 7 modulation。
- RX analysis：[[EIS]] sensitivity verification。
- Spurious：Rx / OOB spurious emissions monitoring。
- Occupied bandwidth。
- Native Wi-Fi / IF / IB band：[[R&S CMP180]]。
- mmWave signal generation and analysis：[[R&S CMP200]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]]。
- R&D fine tuning：[[R&S FSW67]] 與 signal sources。
- Production / manufacturing setup：[[R&S CMQ200]] 與 automation SW WMT 只作為來源列名，尚無詳細流程。

Bluetest Flow › 來源中的定位
- [[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）將 [[Bluetest Flow]] 描述為 integrated test environment for complex wireless solutions。

- 同一來源稱此 integration 可讓 developers and manufacturers of next-generation WLAN technology 使用 [[Bluetest]] RTS 對 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points 進行 MIMO stress testing。
- [[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）明確標示 latest version of [[Bluetest Flow]] software 為 **v1.18**。
- 同一來源說明 [[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18 enable developers to perform [[5G NR Standalone]]（SA）、[[5G NR Non-Standalone]]（EN-DC）與 [[LTE]] testing using [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] within the [[Bluetest]] RTS。
- 同一來源說明 [[Bluetest]] 也 expanded earlier integrated testing capabilities for WLAN stations and access points（[[IEEE 802.11]] a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be），now supporting bandwidth up to 320 MHz for [[Wi-Fi 7]]。

R&S TS9975 EMI Test System › 使用限制
- 本頁只記錄 Market 類簡報中的系統列名；不是 Productions 類 datasheet。
- 不可由 [[2025RS Drone Solution]] 推論 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]] 可覆蓋所有 drone standards 或所有 frequency ranges。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

[[R&S for JIO Project]] 把 WoMT 的核心挑戰描述為 bridging the gap between IEEE and 3GPP：

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。

[Wi-Fi 8](https://www.rohde-schwarz.com/us/solutions/wireless-communications-testing/wireless-standards/wlan-wi-fi/wi-fi-8-testing/wi-fi-8-testing_258504.html "Wi-Fi 8") builds upon the foundation of Wi-Fi 7, retaining core physical layer parameters like supported frequencies up to 7.125 GHz, channel bandwidths up to 320 MHz and 4096QAM modulation, as well as Multi-Link-Operation (MLO). However, to achieve its UHR goals, IEEE 802.11bn introduces a suite of innovative PHY and MAC layer technologies that present new testing hurdles. At MWC 2026, visitors can experience how to address key testing challenges associated with Wi-Fi 8 with the enhanced testing capabilities of the CMX500 one-box signaling tester, one of the most versatile mobile device test platforms in the market, which supports many of the demanding features of Wi-Fi 7 and Wi-Fi 8 today.

answer.text:
Wi‑Fi 7 raises required generator/analyzer bandwidth from older WLAN test coverage of up to 160 MHz to Wi‑Fi 7 support up to 320 MHz, so test equipment must generate and analyze 320 MHz WLAN channels [4][12].
Wi‑Fi 8 retains Wi‑Fi 7 physical-layer parameters including frequencies up to 7.125 GHz, channel bandwidths up to 320 MHz, 4096QAM, and MLO, so Wi‑Fi 8 measurement capability must at least preserve those Wi‑Fi 7-class RF capabilities [25].
Wi‑Fi 7 uses 4096QAM as a throughput-enabling component, so analyzers need modulation-quality measurement suitable for high-order QAM, including EVM where Wi‑Fi 7 modulation is tested [1][17].
For Wi‑Fi over mmWave scenarios, the stated TX analysis items include EIRP, TRP, ACLR, EVM under Wi‑Fi 7 modulation, spurious monitoring, and occupied bandwidth, so analyzers and sources must cover both modulation quality and RF emission metrics [17].
Wi‑Fi 7 adds up to 16 spatial streams and MLO as throughput-related components, so measurement setups need multi-channel and multiple-RF-chain capability rather than only single-link testing [1][7].
Wi‑Fi 7 R&D measurements must be performed in signaling mode under real-world conditions for RF TX/RX characteristics, and MLO makes multiple RF chains crucial [7].
The CMX500 RF architecture includes four RF generators routed to RF Com/RF Out ports and four input signals split to one or two RF analyzers, so it supports multi-port generator/analyzer routing for multi-chain testing [8].
Production-style Wi‑Fi 7 non-signaling RF test is mapped to the CMP180, while R&D signaling/interworking test is mapped to the CMX500 [20].
The CMP180 transmitter-test description supports eight input signals multiplexed to RF analyzer no. 1 and eight input signals multiplexed to RF analyzer no. 2, so it addresses multi-port production transmitter analysis requirements [11].
Wi‑Fi 7 targets extremely high throughput and low latency for UHD video, VR, and AR, so test setups need throughput, PER, E2E, and application-level validation in addition to RF metrics [1][6][24].
Wi‑Fi 8 introduces new PHY and MAC technologies for UHR goals and creates new testing hurdles, so Wi‑Fi 8 extends the test challenge beyond simply repeating Wi‑Fi 7 PHY measurements [25].

cited_passages.text:
Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術背景
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 列出的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] throughput-related components 包含：

| 技術項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| 320 MHz channel bandwidth | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| up to 16 spatial streams | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| 4096 QAM modulation | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| [[MLO]] | key component；also key feature making multiple RF chains important |

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 提供 solution-level update：[[Bluetest]] earlier integrated WLAN testing capabilities 現在支援 [[Wi-Fi 7]] bandwidth up to **320 MHz**。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 則以背景段落描述 [[IEEE 802.11be]] / [[Wi-Fi 7]] 是 next generation Wi-Fi technology，面向 extremely high data throughput、tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。

以上皆為來源對 Wi-Fi 7 與整合測試能力的敘述，不等同於 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[Bluetest Flow]]、[[Bluetest]] RTS 或 [[EMITE]] chambers 對所有 feature combination 的完整規格保證。

R&S CMW500 › 支援技術摘要
- [[R&S CMW500]] 在 [[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]] 中是唯一明確支援 GSM small cell、WCDMA small cell、LTE small cell 的 CMW 型號。
- GSM、NB-IoT、WCDMA、LTE mobile station test 與 NR Sub-6GHz 章節明確標示適用於 [[R&S CMW500]] 與 [[R&S CMW290]]。
- Four RF paths、DAU B450H/I、Digital I/Q 1 to 4 / 5 to 8、Digital I/Q QUAD 章節明確標示 [[R&S CMW500]] 與 [[R&S CMW270]]。
- Bluetooth standard：Bluetooth Core Specification Version 5.0；test standard 包含 RF.TS.5.0.0 與 RF-PHY.TS.5.0.0。
- WLAN 160 MHz bandwidth unit 章節列出 IEEE 802.11a/g/p/n/ac 與 IEEE 802.11ax，bandwidth up to 160 MHz。
- [[CMW-KA096_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]] 補充 [[NGeCall over LTE]]、[[IMS eCall]]、[[IVS]]、[[PSAP]]、[[MSD]]、limited service、callback、clear-down、SRVCC handover 等 eCall 測試語境。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 為什麼需要 OTA 與 multiple RF chains
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 指出，在 WLAN devices development 期間，需要在 real-world conditions in signaling mode 下量測 antennas 以及 RF transmitter / receiver characteristics。由於 [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很關鍵。

同一來源同時將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester；其 flexibility、support for multiple radio technologies 與 embedded IP test capabilities 使其可用於 broad range of Wi-Fi 7-specific tests。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 進一步把 Wi-Fi 7 OTA 測試放入更廣的 [[4G 5G NR WLAN OTA MIMO stress testing]] 情境：同一 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] / [[Bluetest]] RTS workflow 同時涵蓋 WiFi、[[LTE]]、5G SA / NSA 的 radio and antenna performance validation。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 沒有使用 MIMO stress testing 一詞，也沒有提供 RF chains、spatial streams 或 chamber reflection model；它的貢獻是確認另一個 OTA chamber vendor [[EMITE]] 也將 [[R&S CMX500]] 整合到 [[Wi-Fi 7]] OTA measurement solution 中。

R&S CMX500 › RF ports 與 routing
- RF Com 1、RF Com 2：simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing；2 × SnapN；RF input/output to DUT。
- RF In 1、RF In 2：transmitter testing；2 × SnapN；RF input from DUT。
- RF Out 1 to RF Out 4：receiver testing；4 × SnapN；RF output to DUT。
- Receiver test functions：四個 RF generators（其中兩個在 GPRF mode）可 routing 到 RF Com 1、RF Com 2、RF Out 1 to RF Out 4。
- Transmitter test functions：RF Com 1、RF Com 2、RF In 1、RF In 2 ports 的四個 input signals 各可 split 到 one or two RF analyzers。
- FDA tables 支援 user-specific frequency-dependent attenuation corrections。

R&S CMP180 › Transmitter test functions
- 8 input signals to be multiplexed to RF analyzer no. 1。
- 8 input signals to be multiplexed to RF analyzer no. 2。
- frequency-dependent attenuation（FDA）tables for user-specific corrections，分別對 RF 1.1 to RF 1.8 與 RF 2.1 to RF 2.8。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 來源中的測試架構
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）描述的架構為：

- [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 提供 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- [[Bluetest Flow]] control software / integrated test environment 整合 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- [[Bluetest]] reverberation test systems（RTS），例如 [[Bluetest RTS65]]，提供 reverberation chamber OTA environment。
- 測試對象為 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points。
- 測試目標為 MIMO stress testing under realistic conditions。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）補充：

- [[Bluetest]] expanded its earlier integrated testing capabilities for [[WLAN]] stations and access points（[[IEEE 802.11]] a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be）。
- [[Wi-Fi 7]] 現在支援 bandwidth up to **320 MHz**。
- 此能力與 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18 與 [[Bluetest]] RTS 組成 single tester and reverberation test system 的 integrated path。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）補充：

- [[EMITE]] over-the-air chambers 可 combined with the latest sophisticated testing features of [[R&S CMX500]]。
- 整合 enables support of [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] and [[5G RedCap]]。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為支援 non-cellular technologies including latest [[Wi-Fi 7]]，all in a single instrument。
- [[EMITE]] customers obtain a comprehensive environment for accurately assessing performance of [[Wi-Fi 7]] as well as [[5G RedCap]] devices。

Wi-Fi over mmWave Technology › 測試需求
依 [[R&S for JIO Project]] 與 [[R&S solution for Jio project_202509_r3]]，WoMT 測試至少包含：

- OTA precision measurement：使用 [[R&S ATS1800C]] CATR chamber。
- TX analysis：[[EIRP]]、[[TRP]]、[[ACLR]]、EVM under Wi-Fi 7 modulation。
- RX analysis：[[EIS]] sensitivity verification。
- Spurious：Rx / OOB spurious emissions monitoring。
- Occupied bandwidth。
- Native Wi-Fi / IF / IB band：[[R&S CMP180]]。
- mmWave signal generation and analysis：[[R&S CMP200]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]]。
- R&D fine tuning：[[R&S FSW67]] 與 signal sources。
- Production / manufacturing setup：[[R&S CMQ200]] 與 automation SW WMT 只作為來源列名，尚無詳細流程。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

[Wi-Fi 8](https://www.rohde-schwarz.com/us/solutions/wireless-communications-testing/wireless-standards/wlan-wi-fi/wi-fi-8-testing/wi-fi-8-testing_258504.html "Wi-Fi 8") builds upon the foundation of Wi-Fi 7, retaining core physical layer parameters like supported frequencies up to 7.125 GHz, channel bandwidths up to 320 MHz and 4096QAM modulation, as well as Multi-Link-Operation (MLO). However, to achieve its UHR goals, IEEE 802.11bn introduces a suite of innovative PHY and MAC layer technologies that present new testing hurdles. At MWC 2026, visitors can experience how to address key testing challenges associated with Wi-Fi 8 with the enhanced testing capabilities of the CMX500 one-box signaling tester, one of the most versatile mobile device test platforms in the market, which supports many of the demanding features of Wi-Fi 7 and Wi-Fi 8 today.
